name: Sage Accounting
description: Sage Business Cloud contacts, sales invoices, ledger accounts and tax rates.
help: Two ways in. FASTEST: paste the Client ID + secret below, press Connect and approve in the browser. ALTERNATIVE: run the OAuth flow once in the Sage developer portal and paste the Refresh Token. Tokens refresh themselves; rotated ones are saved back automatically. US/CA accounts: also set the Token URL and API base to your regional hosts.

fields.label: Refresh token (filled by Connect, or paste from the OAuth flow)
